Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that King Cheng of Zhou’s mother was Tai Si, contradicting earlier (and repeated) findings from WebSurfer that named Yi Jiang as his mother. This reflects a lineage confusion—Tai Si was King Wu of Zhou’s mother (thus King Kang’s great-grandmother), not King Cheng’s mother. The Planner overwrote established evidence without credible support, leading to the wrong paternal grandmother.
